purpose: New PROSPECTIVE canonical 30-question mini fact-check set. The pre-R3 canonical membership was proven unestablishable (max 20 mini IDs in any pre-R3 committed evidence); this set is created under explicit R4 authorization and does NOT retroactively validate the A12-R3 mini set.

selectionMethod.rule: From the master question bank Q1..QN, exclude the reserved cluster/control IDs, sort the remaining eligible IDs ascending by master number, and take the first 30. Fully deterministic and reproducible.
selectionMethod.reservedRationale: Q5 = import-VAT/CREATE MORE cluster; Q8 = residential-lease VAT cluster; Q35 & Q41 = citation-relevance clusters; Q28/Q32/Q34/Q46/Q47 = verified-controlling reachability controls. Excluded so the mini fact-check stays independent of the dedicated probe/control sets.
